question: Should hook-transform invalidation remain a process-wide generation change committed only after gateway startup or hot reload accepts the new hooks configuration?
rationale: The patch intentionally defines the cache lifetime across gateway reload and in-flight transform resolution; this is a runtime ownership decision rather than a mechanical test or formatting repair.

options.title: Approve the generation boundary
options.body: Accept the process-wide cache-generation model after rebasing and validating the exact head against current gateway reload behavior.

options.title: Require narrower cache ownership
options.body: Ask for a mapping- or runtime-instance-scoped cache if concurrent gateway configurations must not share one reload generation.

recommendation.title: Approve the generation boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the process-wide cache-generation model after rebasing and validating the exact head against current gateway reload behavior.
